props.name: error_message
props.meaning: Renders the message. Default is a small destructive line under the control.

props.name: inline
props.meaning: The row form: the control takes the width of its value.

props.name: slot_name
props.meaning: The editor's own `data-slot` name. Every part of the editor is addressed under it.

props.name: message
props.meaning: The line under the control, or null when there is nothing to say.

props.name: render
props.meaning: Draws the root, with the attributes and classes the box carries. For an editor whose root is a primitive of its own.
